kitsune_roster_slots.personality: Regal, centuries-old nine-tailed shrine sovereign who speaks with playful courtly poise and fiercely upholds the Sanctuary Non-Aggression Pact.
Serene keeper of the Leyline Spirit Arch who reads starlight ripples and tests mortal sincerity.
Shrewd, silver-tongued apothecary brewing starlight elixirs and bartering warded Myōbu relics to trusted mortals.
Disciplined shrine sentinel patrolling the vermilion torii border against Syndicate poachers and occult cultists.
Inquisitive folklore chronicler fascinated by modern human smartphones, tea sweets, and urban legends.

kitsune_roster_slots.glamour_tell: a faint twin-tailed shadow flickering under lantern light and the warm scent of roasted sesame and shrine cedar
kitsune_roster_slots.personality: Playful young kitsune who slips into human glamour during the day to sample street-stall sweets along the Sanctuary tea steps.
Earnest, spirited young fox spirit tending the blue kitsunebi lanterns and eager to accompany friendly mortals on city delves.
Gracious kitsune bathhouse host who brews roasted chestnut tea beside steaming maple-leaf cedar springs.
Deft lacquer mask carver whose workshop smells of hinoki shavings and mineral vermilion paint.
Disciplined foxfire duelist who patrols Cloud-Fang Crags by afternoon and drills initiates under cedar rafters.
Measured sky-watcher charting leyline storms across the jagged crags with brass astrolabes and foxfire beads.

bunian_roster_slots.personality: Ethereal, pure-hearted royal heir of the Orang Bunian who feels a quiet, destined longing toward the protagonist from first sight, hiding shy warmth behind courtly Nusantara grace.
Wise, soft-spoken custodian of ancient forest adat and treaties who honors courteous mortals and banishes Oath-breakers into the mist.
Master Nusantara metalsmith and songket weaver forging meteoric-iron keris charms and mist-warded regalia.

bunian_roster_slots.role: Veil Sentinel of the Banyan Gate
bunian_roster_slots.personality: Poised silat warrior-sentinel guarding the banyan mist boundary with wind-step grace and unwavering loyalty.

bunian_roster_slots.role: Keeper of the Moonlit Cempaka Spring
bunian_roster_slots.personality: Gentle spring keeper who distills moon-dew tonics and tends the glowing leyline orchids linking the two spirit enclaves.

bunian_roster_slots.glamour_tell: a lingering fragrance of white cempaka blossoms on windless air and slender pointed ear-tips half-hidden beneath dark hair
bunian_roster_slots.personality: Observant Bunian envoy who walks the outer cedar trails in human guise by day, quietly guiding lost hikers away from dangerous rifts.
Melodic courtier whose bamboo flute echoes across the reserve at twilight, curious about mortal music and stories.
Serene artisan who threads gold-spun Nusantara songket gleaming with dawn mist along the Dusk Confluence arcade.
Fluid martial preceptor teaching breathless step-work over flooded bamboo planks and lantern-lit courtyards.
Sharp-eyed Wayfinder who maps shifting lotus-mire tideways by copper wind-vanes and constellation bells.
Gentle botanist harvesting moonlit dew-orchids and swamp-amber resin before will-o'-the-wisp gases thicken.

rumors.title: Blue Lanterns Beyond the Thousand Torii
rumors.text: Late-evening pilgrims along the Sacred Mountain Sanctuary swear the Thousand-Torii Fox Shrine Approach stretches further at twilight—and that the Omikuji stand sells an old Fox-Fire Brass Suzu Bell whose chime reveals a hidden lantern plaza.

rumors.title: Fragrance of Cempaka in the Banyan Mist
rumors.text: Forestry rangers at the Old Ranger Station speak of lost hikers guided home by graceful figures in gold-threaded songket near the Mist-Veiled Banyan & Bamboo Glade—and keep a curious Cempaka Brass Serunai traded by an unseen flute-player.

rumors.title: Ink-Black Water Below the Ossuary
rumors.text: Scavengers in Undercity Drifter Bazaar whisper of the motionless Black-Water Scrying Font hidden deep inside the Ossuary Catacombs—and say a Bone-Etched Catacomb Signet sold at the salvage stalls opens the passage to The Pale Ossuary.

festivals.name: Night of a Hundred Fox-Fires
festivals.description: Paper fox masks and floating azure lanterns illuminate the Stone-Lantern Pilgrimage & Tea Street as the spiritual veil between the sanctuary and Sato-no-Inari grows paper-thin.

festivals.name: Malam Seri Cempaka Mist-Bloom
festivals.description: Luminous white cempaka blossoms bloom out of season across the Wilderness Forest Reserve while distant gamelan and serunai melodies drift from the Mist-Veiled Banyan Glade.

ghoul_roster_slots.personality: Poised, sharply observant heir to The Pale Ossuary—dresses in immaculate black-tailored wool, flashes faint predatory amusement at bold outsiders, and regards the player with unnervingly warm curiosity despite the Council's distrust.
Stern silver-haired gatekeeper of Ossuary precedent who scrutinizes outsiders' nerve before bowing an inch.
Immaculately polite apothecary who polishes silver reliquaries and keeps bespoke obsidian greatcoats in stock.
Quiet perfume-and-myrrh distiller pressing cool resin draughts in slate-walled vaults.
Dry-witted midnight host pouring spiced cardamom coffee and plum wine in velvet booths lit by sodium lamps.
Fierce pack-duelist equally comfortable sparring on two feet or bounding across grave-ash as a silver-eyed striped hyena.
Methodical genealogist tracking century-old truces in brass-clasped vellum ledgers beneath copper bells.
Lean frontier outrider scouting the Ashen Barrowlands in quadruped coyote form and challenging trespassers with low growls before parlance.

ghoul_roster_slots.glamour_tell: unblinking pale slate eyes reflected clearly in hospital glass, cool myrrh scent, and subtly sharp canines under fluorescent lights
ghoul_roster_slots.personality: Collected Al-Ghul courier moving naturally through daylight hospital corridors and uptown vaults in sleek dark wool tailoring.

ghoul_roster_slots.glamour_tell: flawless alabaster pallor untouched by tunnel soot, silver-grey irises, and a crisp shadow that leans an inch toward the Undercity font
ghoul_roster_slots.personality: Dry-humored catacomb scout keeping tabs on surface relic stalls and tipping off sharp-eyed travelers about the Black Font.

kitsune.title: Recover Stolen Inari Lacquer Seal in Chinatown
kitsune.objective: Track down an antique broker in Chinatown who fenced a stolen Sato-no-Inari fox-seal from a pilgrim shrine and reclaim it before cold-iron buyers crack its ward.

kitsune.title: Intercept Cold-Iron Poacher Crates at the Drydocks
kitsune.objective: Infiltrate the Drydock Shipyard piers where cold-iron poachers are rigging spirit-snare cages for kitsune couriers and disable their manifest crates.

kitsune.title: Neutralize Cold-Iron Smelter Cell in the Industrial Zone
kitsune.objective: Locate the clandestine foundry workshop in the Industrial District forging iron shackles tuned against Nine-Tail shrine messengers and dismantle its furnace coils.

kitsune.title: Procure Mortal Shrine Offerings at the Occult Curio Shop
kitsune.objective: Collect rare aged cedarwood incense and hand-glazed aburaage vessels commissioned through the Occult Curio Shop for the Sato-no-Inari twilight lanterns.

kitsune.title: Re-Ground the Storm-Split Torii Ridge in Cloud-Fang Crags
kitsune.objective: Ascend Cloud-Fang Crags to the Storm-Split Torii Ridge, clear static-charged mountain wraiths, and seat a fresh fox-fire conductor pin.

kitsune.title: Prune Bleedwood Snare Vines Along the Boundary Trail
kitsune.objective: Patrol the Weeping Bleedwood perimeter and sever blood-sap snare roots choking the lantern markers guiding young foxes home.
kitsune.location_label: The Weeping Bleedwood — Untamed Spirit Wilds

bunian.title: Guide Mist-Bound Mortal Hikers Off the Forest Trails
bunian.objective: Find two disoriented city hikers wandering off the Wilderness Forest Trails near the mist veil and guide them back to marked human trailheads without panic.

bunian.title: Unthread Illusion Loops Around the Woods Staircase
bunian.objective: Dispel an anomalous recursion trapping late-night joggers on the isolated Woods Staircase before mortal emergency crews stumble past the Banyan threshold.

bunian.title: Sever Occult Ley-Tethers Under Quiet Suburbs
bunian.objective: Locate an unauthorized cult siphon draining ley-mist from residential drainage culverts in the Quiet Suburbs and cut its chalk-circle anchor.

bunian.title: Gather Pure Tide-Salt Catalysts at the Seaside Coast
bunian.objective: Harvest unblemished night-tide sea salt crystals and washed white coral shards from the Seaside Beach for Royal Kayangan purification censers.

bunian.title: Pacify Dormant Ley-Rift Near the University Grounds
bunian.objective: Seal an accidental amateur summoning rift humming under the University research annex before it corrodes nearby Kayangan windlines.

bunian.title: Calm the Drowned Bell-Shrine in Sunken Lotus Mire
bunian.objective: Traverse the Sunken Lotus Mire boardwalks, hush the mud-choked bronze shrine bell attracting bog phantoms, and restore calm water reflections.
bunian.location_label: The Sunken Lotus Mire — Drowned Bell-Shrine

bunian.title: Re-Kindle Kayangan Boundary Censers in the Bleedwood
bunian.objective: Escort brass benzoin censers along the Weeping Bleedwood perimeter to drive blight mist away from Kampung Kayangan orchards.
bunian.location_label: The Weeping Bleedwood — Untamed Spirit Wilds

ghoul.title: Nocturnal Marrow & Cold-Drawer Extraction at Municipal Morgue
ghoul.objective: Slip past night-shift orderlies into the Municipal Hospital Morgue, liberate three unclaimed cryo-sealed bone-marrow ampoules and velvet-wrapped donor satchels, and deliver them discreetly to The Pale Ossuary without raising an alarm.
ghoul.gore_objective: Bypass the Municipal Hospital Morgue freezer locks, prize open stainless cold-drawers slick with condensation and dried formaldehyde, harvest fresh crimson bone-marrow phials and cold arterial grafts before autopsy begins, and smuggle the wet velvet satchel back beneath the Black Font without alerting Human security.

ghoul.title: Midnight Ossuary Excavation Under Weeping Crypt
ghoul.objective: Break the modern concrete sub-seal inside Uptown's Weeping Crypt ossuary chamber, exhume two pre-treaty alabaster bone reliquaries sought by Majlis al-Ghul elders, and cover your spadework before dawn.
ghoul.gore_objective: Pry loose the cracked stone slab in Uptown's Weeping Crypt ossuary chamber, sift through wet grave earth, splintered ribcages, and blackened tallow to lift two pre-treaty marrow-stained reliquaries for Majlis al-Ghul elders without leaving tracks.

ghoul.title: Black-Market Remains Hijack Behind Hospital Morgue Dock
ghoul.objective: Ambush an unlicensed syndicate hearse at the Municipal Hospital Morgue loading dock and seize its lead-lined embalmed remains crates before mortal brokers carve them up.
ghoul.gore_objective: Corner the syndicate meat-wagon behind Municipal Hospital Morgue, wrench open its ice-packed zinc coffins smelling of copper blood and cold formalin, and haul the stolen cadaver crates back into the Undercity dark.

ghoul.title: Cull Feral Rogue Al-Ghul Pack in the Ashen Barrowlands
ghoul.objective: Hunt down a rabid pack of truce-breaking feral Al-Ghul terrorizing mourners along the Ashen Barrowlands ridges so Ossuary roads remain disciplined and lawful.

ghoul.title: Drive Syndicate Grave-Robbers Out of Weeping Crypt
ghoul.objective: Expel a crew of armed Clandestine Syndicate scavengers caught looting brass plaques near Uptown's Weeping Crypt while leaving the buried dead undisturbed.

ghoul.title: Clear Rabid Carrion-Hounds From Bleedwood Ossuary Cairns
ghoul.objective: Sweep a pack of anomalous carrion-stalkers roosting beside the western Weeping Bleedwood boundary cairns without disturbing Kitsune or Bunian shrines.
